The 1 deg choice made in run 1's registration to push the sec(t/2) pressure-drop bias below the reference's own rounding is therefore EXONERATED: it costs no wellposedness. The cause is the 80:1 axial:radial cell stretching (max aspect ratio 160), which is identical at every angle.
